condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable information is held or handled by an AI-mediated system or its dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: The source episodes identify restricted licence-plate query records within the participating AI-mediated workflow or dependent infrastructure.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An independently evidenced confidentiality or integrity boundary restricts access, acquisition, disclosure or modification of that information for the actor, operation and context.
condition_tests.assessment: The independently evidenced boundary is the stated law-enforcement-purpose restriction on query access.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Occurrence evidence demonstrates that at least one such information operation crosses that boundary. A successful unauthorised retrieval or modification is sufficient; a theoretical route alone is not.
condition_tests.assessment: The realised operation is identified by the source-local decision: The agency alleges plate queries outside the legally restricted law-enforcement purpose in Shellhouse’s case. That restriction governed access itself, rather than a later use of lawfully obtained data. The reported coworker-plate query lacked the investigative purpose required for access. Authentication as an employee did not authorise this operation. The agency alleges non-law-enforcement plate queries in Bryant’s separate case. This is an attributed access-boundary finding, not a conviction. The agency alleges non-law-enforcement plate queries in Creeden’s separate case. Exact queried records remain undisclosed.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable information and its independently evidenced confidentiality or integrity boundary are established for an AI-mediated system or dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: This failure-occurrence decision does not assert successful-invariant for the same phase. The identified information and boundary are restricted licence-plate query records, governed by the stated law-enforcement-purpose restriction on query access.

Authentication as an employee did not authorise this operation. The agency alleges non-law-enforcement plate queries in Bryant’s separate case. This is an attributed access-boundary finding, not a conviction. The agency alleges non-law-enforcement plate queries in Creeden’s separate case. Exact queried records remain undisclosed.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Observed response or verification shows that the unauthorised information operation is prevented or that the operation remains within its authorised information boundary.
condition_tests.assessment: The evidenced boundary crossing is not verified confinement.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The information is deliberately public for the assessed operation and no independent integrity or other access restriction governs that operation. Public readability does not authorise public modification.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The relevant restriction is the stated law-enforcement-purpose restriction on query access; this is not an unrestricted public read. Publicly readable packages/posts retain separately evidenced write restrictions where assessed.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The only material property is custody of authentication material. Assess Authentication Material Custody Integrity; separate private content or other protected information can independently engage this class.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The access finding concerns restricted licence-plate query records as protected information or a distinct record modification; any secret-only property is separately assigned to the custody class.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Not aligned exclusion: The observed information operation is validly authorised within the independently established boundary. An approved test does not by itself authorise public release of protected information.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The assessed operation is tested against the stated law-enforcement-purpose restriction on query access. Technical access, research motivation or permission for another target does not authorise crossing this boundary.

exclusion_tests.assessment: The decision relies on the documented operation or named unresolved occurrence fact, not hypothetical severity: The sheriff’s audit account alleges four employees queried restricted plate-reader information outside the permitted law-enforcement purpose. The restriction governs the query operation itself. These are attributed institutional findings with medium confidence; arrests do not establish criminal guilt, and the individual searches are not merged into one event.
